overview: The Advisory Team reviewed and recommended a revised site plan for the Medford High School building project, focusing on a more pedestrian-centric layout and distributed parking. The team also discussed designs for the track and field, a new pedestrian breezeway, and the placement of emergency assistance stations.

items.title: Parking Program Update
items.summary: The design team presented a parking program for 477 spaces, noting that the capacity may be adjusted by the superintendent as building programs are finalized.

items.title: Updated Site Layout and Recommendation
items.summary: Approved a recommendation to the School Building Committee for a revised site plan that rotates the rectangular field and distributes parking to improve building sightlines and pedestrian safety. Discussion addressed concerns regarding traffic circulation, accessible parking distribution, and site grading constraints.

items.title: Edgerly Track and Field Design
items.summary: Plans for the Edgerly Track and Field include a synthetic turf field, an 8-lane straight track, and new concession buildings, with preliminary approval from the DCR for structures on deed-restricted land.

items.title: ECC Breezeway and Pedestrian Experience
items.summary: Architects introduced a level 2 'breezeway' pass-through to provide a pedestrian shortcut across the site and create a dedicated entrance for the Curtis Tufts and preschool programs.

items.title: Call for Assistance Stations
items.summary: Security consultants identified several locations for emergency communication towers with blue lights to be placed throughout parking areas and near athletic fields.
